rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person who knows how to deal with others tactfully.

example.english: They are tactful; when they saw the guest looked upset, they stopped asking questions.
example.traditional: 佢識做，見到客人面色唔好就冇再追問。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sik1 zou6 gin3 dou2 haak3 jan4 min6 sik1 m4 hou2 zau6 mou5 zoi3 zeoi1 man6

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone knows what to say or do without going too far.

example.english: You are really tactful; when Auntie did not want to answer, you did not ask again.
example.traditional: 你講嘢真係好有分寸，阿姨唔想答就唔再問。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 fan1 cyun3 aa3 ji1 m4 soeng2 daap3 zau6 m4 zoi3 man6

rows.note: Use this mainly for tactful or appropriately mannered words, actions, or conduct, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: This statement is very tactful: it explains everything clearly without embarrassing anyone.
example.traditional: 呢份聲明寫得好得體，既交代清楚，又冇令人難堪。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 sing1 ming4 se2 dak1 hou2 dak1 tai2 gei3 gaau1 doi6 cing1 co2 jau6 mou5 ling6 jan4 naan4 ham1
